verdict.rationale: EFTPS publishes fixed processing clocks for its main transaction types: enrollment takes up to five business days, the PIN arrives by mail in five to seven business days, payments must be scheduled by 8 p.m. ET the day before the due date, and funds move on the selected settlement date. These are static policy timelines rather than current, live processing times. missing for 10: dynamically updated current processing times or backlog status, per-transaction-type live estimates, and independent corroboration that the published timelines match reality.
